title: Swift package ranged to a whole major version
description: Package.swift declares a range whose upper bound is a whole major release. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a range whose upper bound is a whole major release.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a range whose upper bound is a whole major release.
limitation: It matches a range whose upper bound is a whole major release in the parsed Package.swift; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
